timeline.narration: The Leather Jacket Protocol. A completely fictional parody. In a quiet Taipei tea house, Jensen Huang sits down for what he thinks is an ordinary business catch-up.

timeline.heading: The Spy's Mission
items: Cover story: "just a big fan of graphics cards"
timeline.narration: Across the table is Agent Dumpling, a spy whose mission is to extract next generation chip secrets. Her cover story? She is just a really big fan of graphics cards.

timeline.heading: Interrogation Attempts
items: "Nice jacket. Any secrets in the pockets?"
timeline.narration: Agent Dumpling tries every trick. Subtle questions. Hypotheticals. Even a compliment on the jacket. Each one is met with a warm smile and a forty five minute keynote.

timeline.heading: Information Extracted (minutes)
timeline.narration: By the end of the meeting, the spy has collected zero minutes of secrets, twenty five minutes on leather jackets, and a full hour on how AI will change everything.

timeline.heading: Mission Report
items: Merch obtained: one signed GPU box
New career plan: buy Nvidia stock
timeline.narration: Agent Dumpling files her report. Secrets obtained, none. Merchandise obtained, one signed GPU box. New career plan, become a shareholder.
